name: b2b-crm-saas
description: Nền tảng CRM và quản lý vận hành B2B tích hợp Lark: khách hàng, dự án, công việc, lịch và nguồn lực.

scripts.build:frontend: pnpm --filter @b2b-crm/contracts build && pnpm --filter @b2b-crm/ui-tokens build && pnpm --filter @b2b-crm/web build
scripts.test:e2e:route-smoke: CRM_PUBLIC_SESSION_REQUIRED=1 PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=3903 playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts apps/web/e2e/crm-auth-required.spec.ts apps/web/e2e/constructor-projects.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:public-auth: CRM_PUBLIC_AUTH_SMOKE_REQUIRED=1 CRM_PUBLIC_SESSION_REQUIRED=1 PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=3903 playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts apps/web/e2e/public-auth-smoke.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:public-auth:local-demo: CRM_E2E_START_API=1 CRM_E2E_USE_DEMO_SESSION=1 CRM_PUBLIC_AUTH_SMOKE_REQUIRED=1 CRM_PUBLIC_SESSION_REQUIRED=1 PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=3903 playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts apps/web/e2e/public-auth-smoke.spec.ts
scripts.test:analytics:ga: test -n "$DATABASE_URL" && pnpm --filter @b2b-crm/api exec vitest run src/modules/workforce-analytics && pnpm --filter @b2b-crm/api exec vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts src/modules/workforce-analytics/workforce-analytics.integration-spec.ts && pnpm --filter @b2b-crm/web exec vitest run src/lib/analytics-url-state.spec.ts src/lib/csv-export.spec.ts src/lib/production-route-readiness.spec.ts src/lib/production-analytics-route.spec.ts && CRM_PUBLIC_SESSION_REQUIRED=1 PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=3903 pnpm exec playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts apps/web/e2e/analytics.spec.ts && CRM_PUBLIC_SESSION_REQUIRED=1 PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=3903 pnpm exec playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts apps/web/e2e/crm-auth-required.spec.ts --grep "business BFF routes reject" --timeout=120000
scripts.verify:frontend: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build:frontend && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.audit:security: pnpm audit --audit-level moderate && pnpm audit --prod --audit-level moderate
scripts.db:production:verify: pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:verify-critical-tables && pnpm db:seed:foundation && pnpm db:verify-foundation
